title: viola recorded hyprctl reply fixture
description: One fixtures/hyprland/<hyprland-version>/<Request>.<variant>.json: a relied-on `hyprctl` request read once on the founder's host by the test-only `viola-hypr-tap` through the seam's own read, its argv as one element each, the child's exit code (null when it was killed or ended by a signal) and its stdout as recorded: every string off the request's closed allowlist replaced by the placeholder, then scrubbed. The fake `hyprctl` replays `stdout` byte for byte (test-plan §7 Fixture hygiene).
